name: Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana
benefit:
1. Funeral assistance- ₹6,000/-
1. Ex-gratia payment-

  - In case of normal death : ₹2,00,000/-
  - In case of death due to accident : ₹4,00,000/-
  - In case of permanent disability due to accident : ₹2,00,000/-
  - In case of partial permanent disability due to accident : ₹1,00,000/-
_eligibility_text: 1. The worker must have been registered for at least 6 months before their death. 1. Death can be due to only natural causes or an accident. 1. The worker must have a valid identity card. 1. Benefit will only be provided to following successor- - Wife or husband (as the case may be) of a worker holding a valid identity card - Sons and unmarried and dependent daughters - Dependent parents - If there is none of the above, a family member who is dependent on the deceased worker.
